headline: Product Manager at Tandem Health | Former cellist, former UX researcher
summary: I played cello professionally for eight years before moving into user research and then product. Today I lead the patient app at Tandem Health, which helps people with chronic conditions share symptoms with their care team. Listening is still the core of my job.

experiences.title: Product Manager, Patient App
experiences.description: Owns the patient app used by about 40,000 people. Introduced a weekly symptom check-in that doubled the share of patients who send data before appointments.

experiences.title: UX Researcher
experiences.description: Ran interviews and diary studies with patients and nurses. Built the company's research repository.

experiences.title: Cellist
experiences.description: Section cellist. Toured in 14 countries and recorded three albums.

education.description: Evening course taken while leaving the orchestra.

volunteer_work.description: Teaches free weekly cello lessons to children from low-income families.

projects.title: From Stage to Standup (talk)
projects.description: Conference talk on what orchestra rehearsals teach about product teams.
